subject: Solara Health — IR kickoff and evidence ask (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solarahealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Solara Health — IR kickoff and evidence ask (post-discovery)

Hi Liam / Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions from your security team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you the artifacts you need for procurement and legal review.

Key asks from your side (summary):
- SOC 2 Type II status and most recent report or summary (high level acceptable).
- Incident Response (IR) plan or playbook excerpts that describe escalation and notification windows.
- BCP / DR RTO / RPO targets and any documented recovery exercises.
- Sample breach notification templates (legal-friendly, redacted examples are fine).

What we can deliver this week:
- Redacted IR playbook extract (high level runbooks + escalation matrix) — see attached: redwood-ir-playbook.pdf
- Short SOC 2 Type II summary and scope table (we can share the cert once NDA/portal is in place).
- Draft notification templates and a short FAQ for your ops team.

Proposed timeline:
- I will collate the artifacts and open a secure share by EOD Friday, Nov 20.
- If you need an accelerated package (SOC 2 full report + signed AOC), tell me and we can route through our compliance team; that takes additional gating.

Open question for you: what notification window does your incident policy require for downstream vendors? You mentioned a 72-hour external notification target on the call; want to confirm whether that applies to vendor event reporting or just customer notification.

Next steps:
- I will assemble the package and share via Drive link + HubSpot ticket.
- Mina/Ben from our security ops will follow up on technical details you request (RTOs, logs retention).

Attachments: redwood-ir-playbook.pdf (excerpt)

Thanks — talk soon.

Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solarahealth.com>, Solara Health Security <security@solarahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Solara Health — IR kickoff and evidence ask (post-discovery)

Marcus — thanks for the recap and for the quick turnaround offer. 

Short answers:
- SOC 2: We require evidence of a completed SOC 2 Type II covering security + availability. A short AOC summary is fine initially; we will request the full report if we move forward with a procurement loop.
- Notification window: our vendor policy requires vendor-to-customer notification within 72 hours of detection for incidents that materially affect PHI or customer data; vendor-to-Solara internal notification should be within 24 hours of detection.
- BCP/DR: RTO/RPO expectations depend on the product tier; for our pilot (processing PHI) we want RTO <= 4 hours for critical services and RPO <= 1 hour where possible.

Items we need from you to start:
1) Redacted IR runbook (playbook sections showing detection -> escalation -> notification sequence).
2) Summary table of RTO/RPO by service/component.
3) Sample breach notification templates that include timelines and contact points.
4) Evidence of log retention (where logs are stored, retention period).

I attached a short internal checklist — I've also attached our preferred evidence inventory template so you can drop items directly into the fields we will hand to procurement.

Attachment: solara-evidence-template.xlsx (attached)

If you can share the redacted playbook and RTO/RPO table by EOD Tuesday Nov 24, that would keep us on track for procurement the following week. If you need more time, let us know the earliest feasible date.

Best,
Priya Desai
Security Programs Manager | Solara Health
priya.desai@solarahealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solara Health — IR kickoff and evidence ask (internal)

Marcus / Ben — quick internal note before we respond to Priya's checklist.

- Redacted playbook: I will produce an excerpt that includes the detection -> triage -> escalation matrix and high-level notification decision tree. I will remove internal IPs and vendor-specific endpoints.
- RTO/RPO table: Ben, can you pull the last DR runbook and map expected RTO/RPO per logical service (inference API, auth/session store, KV cache, telemetry pipeline)? Aim for conservative numbers; we can call out which ones are achievable under Dedicated vs Hosted.
- Logs: we retain request logs and auth traces for 180 days in cold storage; last 30 days hot. I'll include the storage locations and retention policy.
- Legal: we should loop legal if Solara requests the full SOC 2 report — Ben, please flag if we need to route via contracts for an NDA/portal.

I can assemble the package into our shared folder and send Marcus a single Drive link for external sharing. Recommend adding a short cover note that explains redactions and points to follow-up items (full AOC behind request).

Mina Haddad
Security Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarahealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solara Health — IR kickoff and evidence ask (post-discovery)

Priya / Liam — thanks for the clear checklist. We've consolidated and are delivering the first tranche of artifacts now.

What we're sending (attached / shared):
- redwood-ir-playbook.pdf (redacted excerpts showing detection->escalation->notification)
- soc2-type2-summary-2024.pdf (scope + controls matrix; full AOC available on request)
- sample-notification-templates.docx (legal-friendly templates; editable)
- RTO-RPO-summary.csv (summary by logical service) — link in Drive

Delivery method and timeline:
- Package shared via Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEF_example
- HubSpot ticket: HS-8421-IR (I will attach the artifacts to the ticket and set visibility to your security contact).
- We will provide RTO/RPO runbook items and logs retention details by COB Monday Nov 23; full DR exercise reports (if requested) may take longer.

Notification windows: we confirm vendor-to-solara internal notification within 24 hours for detection and vendor-to-customer notification within 72 hours for material incidents affecting PHI. We will call out the specific decision points in the redacted playbook.

If Solara would like a short (30 min) walkthrough of the playbook and templates, Mina and Ben can join next week. Let me know preferred slots.

Attachments: redwood-ir-playbook.pdf, soc2-type2-summary-2024.pdf, sample-notification-templates.docx

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
